# [CS027] JWT Parsed Without Signature Verification (jwt-unverified-parse)

Claims are read from a token parsed without verifying its signature.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-347](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/347.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

ParseUnverified decodes any token, so trusting its claims for authentication accepts forged tokens.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
token, _, err := jwt.NewParser().ParseUnverified(raw, &claims)
userID := claims.Subject
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
token, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(raw, &claims, keyFunc, jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"RS256"}))
if err != nil || !token.Valid {
	return errUnauthorized
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [jwt-unverified-parse]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    jwt-unverified-parse: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore jwt-unverified-parse -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** jwt-unverified-parse
```
